BiblicalUsage: Yeâṭ is the Aramaic word for counselling together, for consulting as one. The presidents and princes consulted together to trap Daniel with a royal decree, and the king sent Ezra with his seven counsellors to enquire concerning Judah and Jerusalem.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe counsel can be used to trap the righteous or to send the faithful, and God overrules both.
